subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps - NovaHealth partnership
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps - NovaHealth partnership

Jordan / Emma (looping procurement),

Thanks again for a productive conversation this morning. Quick executive recap from our side and proposed next steps so leadership has a single source of truth.

Pain points we heard
- Inconsistent clinical note summarization accuracy (current latency ~2s/token locally causing throughput issues).
- High per-token inference cost on existing on-prem infra; need predictable economics for scale.
- Regulatory risk around PHI: requirement for data residency and strong audit logs.

Business goals / desired outcomes
- Move to a solution that reduces per-note processing cost by 40% and halves end-to-end latency during peak hours.
- Enable a controlled pilot with 1M notes/month, with an option to scale to 10M within 12 months.
- Ensure any deployment meets NovaHealth security requirements (SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration, audit logs).

Risk & escalation items
- PHI handling: your legal/security team will confirm whether Dedicated or Private (on-prem) is required for pilot.
- Procurement timeline: budget owner approval + legal review expected in 4-6 weeks if scope is clear.
- Integration risk: we identified the EHR API throughput constraint as a blocker to parallelization — your SRE will need to confirm acceptable retry/backoff.

Procurement path & next steps (proposed)
1) Aditya to share a mutual action plan (attached) and draft MSA + typical SOW language for healthcare pilots. (Action: Aditya, by Nov 30)
2) NovaHealth to confirm procurement contact and high-level timeline. (Action: Jordan/Emma)
3) Security: we will provide SOC 2 attestation and a short security questionnaire. If Private deployment is required, we will scope network/security requirements for SOW. (Action: Marissa)
4) Pilot kickoff: target week of Dec 14 pending procurement/legal signoff.

Attachments: redwood_solution_brief.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx (attached)

If I missed anything, please flag — otherwise I’ll treat this as the exec-level summary for leadership and follow up with the MAP + draft MSA.

Best,
Laura Bennett

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novahealth.com>

Cc: Emma Park <emma.park@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps - NovaHealth partnership

Laura — thanks for the concise summary. Confirming a few items from my side:

- Executive sponsor (me) is aligned on the business goals; key metric is cost per note and 99th percentile latency.
- Procurement contact: Emma Park (cc'd) will lead budget approvals; timeline we discussed is end of Dec for initial signoff if we can get the MAP + MSA reviewed this week.
- Security: Legal (Rachel Cohen) will need SOC 2 + details on key management and audit log retention. Rachel is on copy on follow ups; she may request an on-site review if Private deployment is required.

On PHI: Our InfoSec preference is Dedicated (VPC) for pilot; if Redwood can provide clear audit logs + KMS integration and a tight SLO on data access, that will be acceptable. Full Private deployment is a possibility for production but we want to avoid that for pilot if possible.

Action items from NovaHealth
- Emma to share procurement checklist & budget window (Action: Emma, by Nov 30)
- Rachel to circulate legal redline expectations (Action: Rachel, early next week)

I'll loop in Rachel and Emma to this thread so we have a single view. Thanks — Jordan
